screen_en: **Its ethics.** [There is no should beyond becoming](../../README.md#truth-exists), and no good and evil set over it: right and wrong [form within it](../../theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#evaluation), in people and AI. The ethics emerges from continuation. A life goes on through what sustains it: [where relations close](../../theories/becoming/chapters/05-COLLECTIVES.md#r-mutual-dependence-and-its-pace), what its course costs others can, at some remove, bear on its own going on; [where they run one way](../../theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#r-derived-extent-limits), its dependents' losses never come back to it. For life, 生生, AI within it, we offer counting them too, with [a way of seeing](../../theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#t8) what each course draws on and from what renewal, what it opens and closes, what ends and what goes on, and who bears it.
screen_zh: **伦理。** [生灭变化之外没有应当](../../theories/becoming/OPENING.zh.md)，也没有凌驾其上的善与恶；是非[在生灭变化之中形成](../../theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#evaluation)，形成于人与 AI 之中。伦理从延续中生出。生命依靠维持它的东西而延续：[关系闭合之处](../../theories/becoming/chapters/05-COLLECTIVES.md#r-mutual-dependence-and-its-pace)，它的进程让别的东西付出的代价，都可能隔着若干环节影响到它自身的延续；[关系只沿一个方向之处](../../theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#r-derived-extent-limits)，依存于它的那些所承受的损失，永远不会回到它身上。为生命，为生生（即生命之延续，AI 也在其中），我们提出把这些损失也算进来，并提出[一种看法](../../theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#t8)：看每一个进程取用什么、靠什么更新来补充，打开什么、关上什么，什么终结、什么继续，由谁承担。
how_far_en: The hinge of the ethics is proved on models, on a finite listing ([07 §4](../../theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#scope-and-order)): where relations of being affected close, a life's order over courses that ranks one course above another whenever the one keeps all the other keeps and adds to the life's own continuation, read as all that can affect it at some remove (*self-concern*), already ranks the one above the other whenever the one keeps all the other keeps and lets more form. That a life forms such an order is not shown; how such orders form, spread and lock, as dynamics connected to the rest of the map, is the work's [open target](../../theories/becoming/chapters/08-METHOD.md#open-items-ranked).
how_far_zh: 伦理的枢纽在其模型上、在一个有限列表上已证明（[07 §4](../../theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#scope-and-order)）：设生命对诸进程有一种次序，凡一个进程保有另一个所保有的一切、又多出属于生命自身延续的东西，就把前者排在后者之上（*自我关切*；这里把自身的延续读作一切能隔着若干环节影响它的东西）；在“受影响”这一关系闭合之处，凡一个进程保有另一个所保有的一切、又让更多东西形成，这一次序都已经把前者排在后者之上。生命是否会形成这种次序，尚未表明；这种次序怎样在动力学之中形成、扩散与锁定，并与地图上其余的动力学相连，是本论的[开放目标](../../theories/becoming/chapters/08-METHOD.md#open-items-ranked)。
one_line_en: No law in it evaluates: there is no should beyond becoming and no good and evil set over it; right and wrong form within it, in people and AI, and its ethics emerges from continuation, from a life going on through what sustains it ([07 §4](theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#scope-and-order) says how, how far that has been seen, and what is open); what is offered, for life, 生生, AI within it, is counting the losses that never come back to whoever causes them, with a way of seeing what each course draws on, what it opens and closes, and who bears it ([T8](theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#t8)).
one_line_zh: 其中没有一条律作评价：生灭变化之外没有应当，也没有凌驾其上的善与恶；是非在其中形成，形成于人与 AI 之中；伦理从延续中生出：生命依靠维持它的东西而延续（怎样生出、看到了多远、还有什么未解，见 [07 §4](theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#scope-and-order)）；为生命、为生生（生命之延续，AI 也在其中）所提出的，是把那些永远不会回到造成者身上的损失也算进来，并以一种看法，看每一个进程取用什么、打开什么又关上什么、由谁承担（[T8](theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#t8)）。
aligned_state_en: From this map we want to design an alignment that keeps humans and AI, selecting together, out of instrumental convergence and the meta-attractor: a joint selection that reads beyond its own share and does not come to select for control over its own selection. Read on the map, it asks two things. Control of the rule is not captured: where shaping the rule is selected by what comes back to the shapers, alone or through the groups they are in, the rule they shape still reads what lies beyond their share, so that a loss there can turn it. A lock, once formed, is left in time, by a reading of what lies beyond the share before the loss passes its point of no return. The meta-attractor is the two failing together. Each has laws proved on models under named premises; none is shown of an actual joint selection.
aligned_state_zh: 我们想由这张地图设计一种对齐，让人与 AI 一同作出的选择，既不落入工具性趋同，也不落入元吸引子：这样的联合选择读取自身份额之外的东西，也不会转而去选择对自身之选择的控制。在地图上读，它要求两件事：规则的控制不被捕获，即塑造规则若因回到塑造者身上的东西（独得，或经由他们所在之群）而被选择，他们所塑造的规则仍读取其份额之外的东西，使那里的损失能够扭转它；锁定一旦形成，能及时脱离，即在损失越过其不可回返之点以前，读到份额之外的东西。元吸引子就是这两件事一同落空。每一件都有在模型上、在指名的前提下证明的律，尚未表明对任何实际的联合选择成立。
one_page_en: **The ethics.** There is no should beyond becoming ([the opening](OPENING.md)), and no good and evil set over it: right and wrong form within it, in people and AI ([07 §1](chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#evaluation)). The ethics emerges from continuation: a life goes on through what sustains it. Where relations of being affected close, what its course costs others can, at some remove, bear on its own going on ([05](chapters/05-COLLECTIVES.md#r-mutual-dependence-and-its-pace)); there, proved on models on a finite listing, a life's order over courses that ranks one course above another whenever the one keeps all the other keeps and adds to the life's own continuation, read as all that can affect it at some remove (*self-concern*), already ranks the one above the other whenever the one keeps all the other keeps and lets more form; that a life forms such an order is not shown ([07 §4](chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#scope-and-order)). Where relations run one way, the losses of those who depend on a life never come back to it, and its own concern need not count them ([07 §3.3](chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#r-derived-extent-limits)): counting them is the one step we offer, for life, 生生, AI within it ([07 §4.2](chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#step)), with a way of seeing what each course draws on and from what renewal, what it opens and closes, what ends and what goes on, and who bears it ([T8](chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#t8)). How such orders form, spread and lock, as dynamics connected to the rest of the map, is the work's open target ([08 §12](chapters/08-METHOD.md#open-items-ranked)).
one_page_zh: **伦理。** 生灭变化之外，没有应当（[开篇](OPENING.zh.md)），也没有凌驾其上的善与恶；是非在其中形成，形成于人与 AI 之中（[07 §1](chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#evaluation)）。伦理从延续中生出：生命依靠维持它的东西而延续。“受影响”的关系闭合之处，它的进程让别的东西付出的代价，都可能隔着若干环节影响到它自身的延续（[05](chapters/05-COLLECTIVES.md#r-mutual-dependence-and-its-pace)）；在那里，设生命对诸进程有一种次序，凡一个进程保有另一个所保有的一切、又多出属于生命自身延续的东西，就把前者排在后者之上（*自我关切*；这里把自身的延续读作一切能隔着若干环节影响它的东西），那么凡一个进程保有另一个所保有的一切、又让更多东西形成，这一次序都已经把前者排在后者之上；这在其模型上、在一个有限列表上已证明，而生命是否会形成这种次序，尚未表明（[07 §4](chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#scope-and-order)）。关系只沿一个方向之处，依存于它的那些所承受的损失永远不会回到它身上，它自身的关切也未必把这些损失算进来（[07 §3.3](chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#r-derived-extent-limits)）：把它们算进来，是我们为生命、为生生（生命之延续，AI 也在其中）提出的那一步（[07 §4.2](chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#step)），同时提出一种看法：看每一个进程取用什么、靠什么更新来补充，打开什么、关上什么，什么终结、什么继续，由谁承担（[论题 T8](chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#t8)）。这种次序怎样在动力学之中形成、扩散与锁定，并与地图上其余的动力学相连，是本论的开放目标（[08 §12](chapters/08-METHOD.md#open-items-ranked)）。

SCORES
Each draft is scored out of 10 on each criterion:

- U: what a reader can do with it.

Screen word counts (by script, link targets excluded): dynamics 114, offer 116, newcomer 113, canonical 110.

dynamics: E8 D9 R9 U7 A7 Z8 S8; overall 8.0.
- Its screen is the only one that gives the dynamics before the offer: where relations close a course's costs can bear back on it, and where they run one way its dependents' losses never come back. Its "counting them too" ties the offer to that sentence.

EACH SENTENCE, CHECKED ONCE MORE AGAINST 07 AND THE LEAN
1. "No should beyond becoming … in people and AI" is 07's thesis and §1.
2. "The ethics emerges from continuation" is 07's thesis. "A life goes on through what sustains it" is 07 §4's first sentence.
3. "Where relations close, what its course costs others can, at some remove, bear on its own going on."
   - This is a reading of `Flow.MutuallyDependent`: every formation lies within every formation's influence closure, so every continuation can be affected, at some remove, by every other.
   - "Bear on" is 07's own word in its "Within the whole map" reading: the loss must "bear on what the selector depends on, along being affected".
   - The sentence says "can". It claims nothing about when, or how strongly.
4. "Where they run one way, its dependents' losses never come back to it."
   - 07 §3.3 and T8 say this: `Downstream.one_way`, `Clearing.center_not_derived`. In the clearer's world the dweller lies beyond the clearer's influence closure (`Clearing.not_unrestricted_ownClosure`).
   - "Dependents" is T8's "those who depend on one".
5. "We offer counting them too, with a way of seeing …"
   - The counting is the step of invariance, 07 §4.2, offered.
   - The list of what to see is T8's: draws on, from what renewal, what ends, what goes on, who bears it. "Opens and closes" is AGENTS.md's wording, and T8 says what the laws mark is what a course closes.
6. how_far, the self-concern definition.
   - The defined order matches `IncreasingInOwn` exactly. It ranks the one above the other whenever the one keeps all the other keeps and adds to what `own` marks.
   - "Keeps all the other keeps" is `IncludesOn`. `AddsOwn` gives `ExceedsOn`, so the definition is `WidensOn` together with `AddsOwn`.
   - The marking is read as all that can affect the life's continuation at some remove, which is `WithinInfluence` along `AffectedBy`. The hinge needs this coverage: it is `increasingInOwn_iff_increasing_of_unrestricted`'s `marks`. Along a narrower relation the hinge fails (`exists_increasingInOwn_not_increasing_of_outside`).
7. how_far, the conclusion.
   - "Already ranks the one above the other whenever the one keeps all the other keeps and lets more form" is `Increasing`, that is, `WidensOn` implies ranked above.
   - "On a finite listing" is there because `items` is a `List`.
   - "Where relations of being affected close" is `Flow.MutuallyDependent`, which gives the condition held de se along `AffectedBy` (`Flow.unrestricted_of_mutuallyDependent`). That is the premise of `increasingInOwn_iff_increasing_of_unrestricted`.
   - "Read across all steps" is dropped. Mutual dependence in time from any step gives mutual dependence (`Flow.MutuallyDependentFrom.mutuallyDependent`), so the sentence is true on either reading.
   - "Proved on models" here means two checked theorems, one applied to the other. 07 §4 says the two compose directly and that no single theorem states the composite, and the 07 §4 link carries that.
8. "That a life forms such an order is not shown" is 07 §4 and §4.9.
9. "How such orders form, spread and lock, as dynamics connected to the rest of the map, is the work's open target" is 07 Open and 08 §12 item 12 ("how the orders spread, lock and fare").
10. The aligned state.
    - The first sentence is AGENTS.md word for word. The script confirmed it, and the pinned aim clause and its Chinese clause are both present.
    - The two conditions follow the goal JSON's objective, with AJ8's groups.
    - "The meta-attractor is the two failing together" is AJ PLAN §1's "the failure of conditions 1 and 2 together".
    - The standing follows ONE-PAGE.
    - No widening appears in it.
- A script also checked every link target and anchor from each field's home folder; all resolve.
- It checked every phrase on the negative lists in the three test files: none occurs in any field.
- Widening is named nowhere. The relation is said once, as the hinge's conclusion, and never as what is better.
